name: Analytic temperature fit · Thermo4
formula: x = T/Tₛ;  φ(T) = [1, x, x ln x, x²];  ŷ(T) = φ(T)ᵀc
inputs: Training temperatures of the SAME phase or pair
note: For the SiO₂ coefficient readouts Tₛ = 1000 K. y is the declared G or ΔG label. Other archives use equivalent rescaled bases; their coefficient numbers are not interchangeable.

name: QH + analytic residual
formula: r(T) = yref(T) − B(T);  ŷ(T) = B(T) + φ(T)ᵀcᵣ
inputs: Declared baseline plus training thermodynamic labels
note: B is the exact archived baseline. A fit against a legacy unstable-mode baseline is a numerical control, not certified QHA.

name: Direct structure–temperature regression
formula: Ĝᵢ(T,P) = fθ(zᵢ,T,P)
inputs: Frozen structural representation plus allowed thermal labels
note: Pressure is included only where the archived model uses it. Pair-trained runs constrain differences fθ(i)−fθ(j); they do not independently fix absolute phase gauges.

name: QH + learned residual
formula: Ĝᵢ(T) = Bᵢ(T) + rθ(zᵢ,T) + ctrain
inputs: Frozen representation, declared baseline and allowed residual labels
note: Shown reconstruction is the audited Hf convention. The cell output is divided by atom count before addition. B already includes static energy where declared; never add it twice. A shared calibration constant cancels in a phase difference.

name: Phase-ID temperature regression
formula: Ĝᵢ(T,P) = fθ(onehot(i),T,P)
inputs: Phase identity and training labels
note: Known-phase control. An unseen phase has no learned identity-specific thermodynamic relation.

name: Volume readout
formula: uᵢ = standardize(Vᵢ/Nᵢ);  ĉᵢ = b + Wᵀuᵢ;  Ĝᵢ(T) = φ(T)ᵀĉᵢ
inputs: One equilibrium structure; source thermodynamic labels
note: V/N is volume per atom. Source-only scaling. Phase coefficient contrasts, not cross-system absolute coefficients, provide gauge-compatible supervision.

name: DPA readout
formula: zᵢ = pool(DPAθ₀(Rᵢ));  ĉᵢ = b + Wᵀ standardize(zᵢ);  Ĝᵢ(T) = φ(T)ᵀĉᵢ
inputs: Frozen checkpoint and equilibrium structure; source thermal labels
note: Checkpoint, branch, pooling and structure exposure are experiment-specific. Thermal-label holdout does not automatically mean structure-zero-shot.

name: DPA + volume readout
formula: hᵢ = [standardize(zᵢ), standardize(Vᵢ/Nᵢ)];  ĉᵢ = b + Wᵀhᵢ
inputs: Same source labels, frozen DPA and explicit volume
note: Coordinate scaling is primary. Equal-block sensitivity divides each standardized block by √(block dimension), including the 128D DPA block. The scaling changes ridge geometry; it adds no independent source-phase contrast.

name: Coefficient-readout training
formula: W* = argminW { tr[(XW − Y) H (XW − Y)ᵀ]/n + λ‖W‖²F };  H = meantrain[φφᵀ]
inputs: Source-pair feature differences X and source coefficient differences Y
note: This is the checked SiO₂ A/B/C objective. Features, temperature metric and regularization are fitted/selected on source data. Phase-level predictions preserve ΔGAB + ΔGBC + ΔGCA = 0.

name: Quadratic-volume control
formula: ŷ = a + b v + d v²;  v = V/V₀
inputs: Source volume states and fixed-temperature labels
note: Carbon follow-up: y = Svib(300 K), not a Thermo4 coefficient. This is distinct from the original linear-volume baseline.

name: Fixed-temperature entropy readout
formula: Ŝvib(300 K) = b + wᵀh;  h ∈ {v, zDPA, [zDPA,v]}
inputs: Fixed-volume harmonic entropy labels on source structures
note: A scalar readout, not a fitted G(T) curve. LOOV and whole-phase holdout have different source supports.

name: Curvature-summary readouts
formula: qᵢ = summarize(Γ-curvature queries);  ĉᵢ = b + Wᵀhᵢ;  hᵢ ∈ {qᵢ, [vᵢ,qᵢ], [zᵢ,qᵢ]}
inputs: Archived six-component Γ summaries; source thermal labels
note: These are model-derived summaries, not an independently verified DFT Hessian or a full phonon free energy. Imaginary-mode information was retained as input.

name: Carbon kernel-ridge control
formula: k(v,v′) = exp[−γ(v−v′)²];  ŷ(v*) = k*ᵀ(K + λI)⁻¹y
inputs: Source volume and entropy labels
note: Kernel and penalty selection follow the archived nested source-fold protocol. A DPA-kernel readout discussed elsewhere remains a separate unrun proposal.

name: Nearest-volume and source-mean controls
formula: ŷ(v*) = yargmin|v−v*|;  ŷmean = meansource(y)
inputs: Source volume states / scalar labels
note: Carbon controls. Separately, the metal family-mean control averages legal source-system relative curves with matched phase order and reference conventions.

name: Family-mean relative-curve control
formula: ΔĜtarget(T) = meanlegal source systems[ΔGsource(T)]
inputs: Source-family paired curves; no target thermal labels
note: Eligibility depends on the source-family transfer contract. A zero-gap null predicts ΔĜ = 0; ties are not a correct stable-phase prediction by default.

name: Pretrained potential
formula: Û = Uθ₀(R);  F̂ = −∇R Uθ₀;  Ĥ = ∇²R Uθ₀
inputs: Frozen pretrained checkpoint
note: The main intervention uses the MP_traj branch. The Omat24 sensitivity is a different pretrained branch, not a fine-tuning step.

name: Raw-force fine-tuning
formula: Lraw(θ) = meanframes ‖Fθ(R) − FDFT(R)‖²
inputs: Existing DFT forces on displaced supercells
note: Forces-only training; energy and virial loss weights are zero. Lower validation raw-force RMSE did not improve the held-out thermal endpoint.

name: Fixed-offset force fine-tuning
formula: ρᵢ⁰ = Fθ₀(Rᵢ⁰);  yᵢ(u) = FDFT(Rᵢ⁰+u) + ρᵢ⁰;  Loffset = mean ‖Fθ(Rᵢ⁰+u) − yᵢ(u)‖²
inputs: Same force data plus fixed pretrained equilibrium-force offset
note: Second attempt on the same test split. It isolates response at initialization when the DFT residual is negligible. It is not a pure response loss throughout training: Fθ(Rᵢ⁰) can change.

name: Displacement-response diagnostic
formula: Dθ(u) = Fθ(R⁰+u) − Fθ(R⁰);  eresponse = Dθ(u) − DDFT(u)
inputs: Equilibrium and displaced forces
note: A measured diagnostic. Explicitly minimizing ‖eresponse‖² throughout training is different from fixed-offset label training and was not run in this snapshot.

name: Model-relaxed harmonic workflow
formula: R* = relax[Uθ];  F̂pipeline(T) = Uθ(R*) + Fvib[Hθ(R*),T]
inputs: Model relaxation, force constants and stable harmonic modes
note: Score the same successful subset and separately report failures over the original pool. This is not QHA, thermal expansion or an anharmonic phase diagram.

name: Harmonic vibrational reference
formula: ω² = eig(M⁻¹ᐟ² H M⁻¹ᐟ²);  Fvib = Σqν wq {ℏων/2 + kBT ln[1 − exp(−ℏων/kBT)]};  Fth = Fvib(T) − Fvib(0)
inputs: Stable phonon spectrum, masses and q weights
note: Normalize per atom consistently. Remove only the appropriate translational zero-mode treatment; do not delete imaginary branches to claim a valid conventional harmonic free energy.

name: Verified quasi-harmonic reference
formula: GQHA(T,P) = minV [E₀(V) + Fvib(T,V) + PV]
inputs: Several admissible volumes; compatible static and phonon references
note: Static energy is included once. The admitted carbon QHA layer is separate from legacy “QH-like” numerical baselines and from finite-temperature effective-harmonic source tables.

name: Thermodynamic integration and DFT correction
formula: ΔFA→B = ∫₀¹ ⟨UB − UA⟩λ dλ;  ΔFML→DFT = −kBT ln⟨exp[−β(UDFT−UML)]⟩ML
inputs: Equilibrated path sampling and overlapping energy distributions
status: Source-reference methods / new Fe route incomplete
note: Equations describe canonical classical configurational paths. State quantum/classical nuclear treatment, electronic temperature and Hamiltonian separately. A runnable trajectory is not an accepted free-energy label.

name: Reference-component replacement
formula: a = δΔ(E₀+EZP);  b(T) = δΔFth(T);  e = a+b;  eanchor-replaced = b;  ethermal-replaced = a
inputs: Target reference component
note: An anchor including ZPE requires phonons. Static-DFT-only correction leaves δΔZPE + b, not b.

name: Coupling and shrinkage corrections
formula: ΔF̂corr = ΔF̂raw − ê;  ê = X kLOFO
inputs: Leave-one-formula-out linear error prediction
note: M3s: correct static ΔE₀, then regress residual δΔZPE+δΔFth on δΔE₀. M3z: predict total error from model ΔZPE and ΔFth. M3sz: correct static ΔE₀, then predict remaining error from those model features. No intercept. These are distinct information budgets; shrinkage is not established physical scale repair.

name: Target-label offset / slope calibration
formula: ΔĜcorr(T) = ΔĜraw(T) + a + b(T−T₀)
inputs: Declared target thermal labels or oracle crossing-region labels
note: One-label offset sets b=0; two-label linear correction fits a,b. Oracle gap+slope uses 11 target temperatures around its diagnostic T₀ and is not a cheap zero-shot method.

name: Risk–coverage decision rule
formula: τ−f = quantile1−α(|eother formulas|);  decide if |ΔF̂| > τ−f;  risk = P(wrong | decided);  coverage = P(decided)
inputs: Other-formula reference errors for threshold calibration
note: Report thresholds, eligible pairs and weighting. α is not a universal guarantee on selective risk.

name: Unrun response-aware objectives
formula: Lresponse = mean ‖[Fθ(R+u)−Fθ(R)] − [FDFT(R+u)−FDFT(R)]‖²;  LHVP = mean ‖Hθv − Hrefv‖²
inputs: Independent responses / Hessian-vector products
status: Not run in this project snapshot
note: Frequency weighting remains unspecified. No 1/ω² training rule is established. Large MLP, DPA-kernel and the proposed volume-plus-DPA-residual head are not reported as completed experiments. F2/F3 were deferred, with no executed method to summarize.
